countries.reasoning: Turkey is the world's largest boron ore producer as per USGS Mineral Commodity Summaries 2024. Production figures and market share are well-documented and stable over the recent years with consistent output.
The US is a major boron producer with large mining operations, chiefly from California, reported by USGS 2024 data. Production data are reliable and consistent.
Russia produces significant boron quantities from its mines but less than Turkey and the US. Data from national industry reports and USGS provide a reasonable estimate with some reporting lags.
Argentina is growing in boron production, especially through brine extraction methods. Data is available but less comprehensive compared to top producers, from regional mining reports.
China has moderate boron production mainly from domestic mines documented by industry reports and governmental data. Precise figures vary slightly but recent data suggest this share.
